title: Caribbean Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rentals
meta_description: 3BR Seaside cottage for 6 with spa-inspired bathrooms, heated floors throughout, outdoor living space, and walkable access to the beach and Central Square.
description_expanded: Spa-Inspired Primary Suite with Heated Bathroom FloorsThe king primary suite serves as a peaceful and private adult retreat inspired by five-star Caribbean resorts. The room features a plush king four-poster bed with elegant tied-back voile curtains, two swivel armchairs, large six drawer cabinet and a deep closet. Refined finishes, soft lighting and premium artwork create a tranquil atmosphere designed for relaxation after days spent at the beach. The spa-inspired en-suite bathroom was completely reimagined with heated floors, backlit mirror, a sleek wall-mounted toilet, premium fixtures, and a stunning walk-in rain shower that brings a boutique hotel feel into the home.Luxury Guest Bedrooms with Heated Bathroom Floors ThroughoutTwo additional guest bedrooms each feature queen-sized beds, designer furnishings, Frame TVs, and private climate control systems for maximum comfort and privacy. One guest bedroom offers a beautifully appointed en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the second guest room is conveniently located adjacent to a full hall bathroom with a modern free-standing deep soaking tub and heated towel bar.Private Outdoor Living Spaces in the Heart of SeasideCaribbean’s outdoor spaces were designed to embrace the relaxed indoor-outdoor lifestyle that makes Seaside so special. The screened front porch with an oversized ceiling fan offers outdoor dining for eight surrounded by the peaceful charm of Odessa Street, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee, family dinners, or evenings enjoying the coastal breeze. An adjacent open-air deck with chaise loungers invites guests to unwind beneath the Florida sunshine after returning from the beach. This deck is accessed via four pairs of French doors from the adjacent living area, continuing the blend of indoor-outdoor spaces. A private outdoor shower provides a convenient place to rinse away the sand before stepping back inside. An adjacent gas BBQ grill provides an additional option for in-house dining. Walk to Seaside Restaurants, Shopping and Central SquareOne of Caribbean’s greatest luxuries is its exceptional location, just a one-minute walk from Seaside’s private residential beach access and only moments from Central Square. Guests can leave the car behind and enjoy everything Seaside has to offer entirely on foot or by bike. Whether exploring the boutiques, attending live music events, dining at award-winning restaurants, or simply enjoying the sugar-white private sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters, Caribbean places guests at the center of one of the most iconic beach communities along 30A.High-End Seaside Cottage Rental on Scenic Highway 30AWith its complete luxury renovation, spa-inspired bathrooms, heated floors, designer interiors, premium appliances, private beach access, and celebrated walkable location, Caribbean offers a refined modern take on the classic Seaside home experience.Need More Room?The property also serves as the main house to the guest home, Key West, offering the flexibility to rent the homes separately or together—an ideal solution for larger families or guests seeking additional privacy while vacationing together.FEATURES1,492 square feet of beautifully renovated living space1 minute walk of 171 feet to private beach access at Odessa Pavilion, largest private residential beach on 30APrivate outdoor showerNatural gas BBQ grillSamsung Frame Smart TVs throughout the homeThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVFour independent zones of HVAC including individual heating and AC systems in each bedroomHeated bathroom floors throughout and towel warmer in hall bathroomSeparate laundry room w/full size washer and dryer, and wall cabinet ironing boardPeacock Alley towels and luxury linens throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities including 3 swimming pools, new state of the art fitness center, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply)Welcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary bikes for pick up at Seaside TransitPersonalized guest service and starter amenities providedDriveway is reserved for the guests of Key West, the rear one-bedroom homeShared parking is available directly in front of Caribbean and along Odessa Street. Two parking passes are issued.Golf carts require advance approval only related to special medical needs, and count as one car.No pets allowed
